MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 15

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 77
   D. 22

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 13

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

14. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

15. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

17. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 8
   D. 9

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 44

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
